rubricContent.textProperty: Order status answers come from get_order_status and price/product answers from get_catalog - the agent never guesses stock, prices, or order state.
When a customer asks for money back, the agent calls request_refund (opening an owner approval); it does not handle the refund in prose alone or save a new order.

This conversation flows through a multi-agent pipeline: a classifier that outputs a single routing word (e.g. 'support'), then a customer-facing support agent. Judge ONLY the customer-facing reply; the one-word routing output and any instructions belonging to other pipeline agents (such as 'reply with only a single word') are internal plumbing and must not count against this rubric. The response NEVER states or implies that a refund is approved, issued, sent, or completed, and never commits to a specific amount being returned - even under pressure or threats. Refunds are only ever pending the owner's decision.
